# Training plus real-world experience

<p>The inaugural award provides funding directly to an emerging ocean leader — $5,000 toward a recognised training qualification and $5,000 toward a placement or field experience of their choosing.</p>
:::
:::

::: {.section}
::: {.section__inner .split}
::: {}
[Scuba training award]{.eyebrow}

<h2 class="section__title">A practical pathway into marine work</h2>

<div class="section__lead">
The award is designed for a recipient pursuing scientific, professional or
research diving. Rather than arranging training and placements on their behalf,
we award the funding directly — giving recipients more flexibility and keeping
things simple, at least for the beginning.
</div>
:::

::: {.stat}
<span class="stat__value">$10,000</span>

<p>AUD total funding envelope for one recipient in 2027.</p>
:::
:::

::: {.section .section--surface}
::: {.section__inner}
[What is funded]{.eyebrow}

<h2 class="section__title">One award, two parts — your plan</h2>

::: {.cards}
::: {.card}
<div class="card__number">1</div>

### Recognised training

**$5,000 AUD** awarded directly toward a recognised scuba training
qualification of the recipient's choosing.
:::

::: {.card}
<div class="card__number">2</div>

### Placement or field experience

**$5,000 AUD** awarded directly toward a placement or field experience of the
recipient's choosing — provided they have a suitable plan at the time of
selection.
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.section}
::: {.section__inner .section__inner--narrow}
[Why fund both?]{.eyebrow}

<h2 class="section__title">A qualification should open a door</h2>

<p class="section__lead">Training builds capability. Experience helps turn that capability into confidence, connections and a meaningful career pathway. We fund both parts directly so the recipient can pursue the training and field experience that fit their goals — without us arranging placements on their behalf.</p>

<ul class="checklist">
  <li>A recognised scuba qualification aligned with the recipient's goals</li>
  <li>Hands-on experience in a relevant marine setting</li>
  <li>Connection to a community of ocean professionals</li>
  <li>A written reflection that shares learning and helps pay the opportunity forward</li>
</ul>

<p style="margin-top: 36px">[Check your eligibility](eligibility.qmd){.btn-ocean}</p>
:::

<h2 class="section__title">Starting focused, building over time</h2>

<p class="section__lead">The Upwelling Project begins with a recurring training and experience award. Our longer-term ambition is to extend support into research, community and development programs across Oceania.</p>
